title: Start a follow-up from recently done work

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage: Caught

- **Story and revision:** SEED-273#follow-up-from-done (.planning/seeds/SEED-273-follow-up-from-done.md), plan 526-follow-up-from-done, completed work revision a92aa00f02d2c8e071ea0497816c10ad83a4502e.
- **Promise:** "A follow-up of a different entry is a different launch even with the same request and choices", and "repeating the same follow-up resumes it". Expected observable behavior: a follow-up of another done story with the same words and choices starts its own launch, sending that story's own follow-up context.
- **Fault:** dashboard/src/followUpRequest.ts, `followUpSourceKey`, story branch changed from `` `story ${followUp.story.identity}` `` to `` `story` ``, so every done-story follow-up shares one source key and `sameLaunch` (dashboard/src/launchRequest.ts, via `sameFollowUpSource`) treats follow-ups of different stories as the same launch. Fixture and assertions were left intact.
- **Fixture:** dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-follow-up-story.spec.ts:138, "follow-ups of two stories with the same words and choices are two launches, and repeating one resumes its kept start" (boundary server mode, real bare origin, fake GitHub publishing done records for SEED-269 and SEED-267, synthetic `claude`). A refused SEED-269 follow-up is kept; then a SEED-267 follow-up and a repeated SEED-269 follow-up are started with the same instruction "Continue" and policy isolated/review.
- **Maintained assertion:** line 174, `expect(calls[1]?.argv.at(-1)).toContain(storyContextOf(otherStory, completedAt, "no session"))`.
- **Run observations:**
  - Baseline: the focused command passed. The selected test ran (1 passed, 3.8s).
  - Fault: 1 failed at line 174. Reach and behavior: the earlier assertions passed (`other` and `resumed` launched, two kept attempts, three claude calls). The second claude call, which was the SEED-267 follow-up, received the SEED-269 follow-up context ("Done story “SEED-269#recover-terminal-insert …”") instead of SEED-267's. This shows that the follow-up of a different story was matched to the kept SEED-269 start and resumed with that start's recorded context. That is the wrong behavior on the intended sameLaunch identity path.
  - Restoration: a shell EXIT trap copied back the saved original. `git status --porcelain` was empty and `git diff --quiet` was clean, which matches the pre-probe state (an isolated detached worktree at a92aa00f0 with 0 changes). The same focused command passed again (1 passed, 3.6s).
- **Command:** in scratch worktree /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/4efd190f/tmp/ic-scratch (detached at a92aa00f0, set up with `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm` and `browser`): `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npx playwright test --config dashboard/playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-follow-up-story.spec.ts -g "two stories with the same words" --reporter=list`. The execution checkout was never edited, stashed or reset. The scratch worktree remains registered for the caller to remove (`git worktree remove /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/4efd190f/tmp/ic-scratch`).
